recognize_zh: 血片中多個中型淋巴細胞，核圓至卵圓、染色質均勻呈毛玻璃樣、無明顯核仁，胞質淡灰藍且量中等，細胞邊緣一圈細長毛髮狀突起，是典型的毛狀細胞白血病（hairy cell leukemia）細胞。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells, roughly 1.5–2 times red cell diameter
Round to oval, occasionally slightly indented nuclei with homogeneous ground-glass chromatin
Moderate pale grey-blue cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, homogeneous finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cells have a moderate amount of pale grey-blue cytoplasm with fine, circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections. No blasts are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia; flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123 positivity) and BRAF V600E testing are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a prominent central nucleolus and present with high WBC without monocytopenia, and are CD25 and CD123 negative and BRAF wild-type.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have short polar villi and more clumped chromatin, and are CD103 and annexin A1 negative.
Prolymphocytes have a single prominent nucleolus and moderately condensed chromatin without circumferential hairy projections.
CLL cells are smaller with scant cytoplasm and coarse soccer-ball chromatin, and are CD5/CD23 positive.
